help_businesstypes-gunstore_content:
**Gun Store** businesses operate out of retail buildings.

Some of this store's items can be ordered from [Importers](importers-contract) in your [Headquarters](businesstypes-headquarters), and some can be manufactured in your [Factory](businesstypes-factory).

Customers are self-serving.

The business requires the following furniture to function:

* [Stack of Shopping Baskets](furniture-stackofshoppingbaskets)
* [Point of Sales](furniture-itemgrouppointofsale)
* At least one product to sell (see below)

Businesses of this type primarily sell:

* [AK67](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_ak47)
* [Peralta M9](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_berettam9)
* [Win-Cheater SXP](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_wincheatersxp)
* [RPG 4U](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_rpg)
* [Ammunition (Small)](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_ammosmall)
* [Ammunition (Large)](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_ammolarge)

Employees with the following skills can be assigned:

* [Customer Service](skill-customerservice)
* [Security Guard](skill-securityguard)
help_products-gunstore-businesstype:item:
**AK67** is a type of product primarily sold from [Gun Stores](businesstypes-gunstore).

The product can be placed in the following furniture:
* [Product Panel](furniture-productpanel)
* [Rounded Shelf](furniture-roundedshelf)

The product can be imported from the following locations:
* [BlueStone Imports](address: 4 pier)

The product can be manufactured at a [Consumer Goods Workstation](furniture-consumergoodsworkstation) using:
* [Plastic](products-plastic) x50
* [Gun Parts (cheap)](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_gunpartscheap) x40
* [Gun Parts (expensive)](products-gunstore-businesstype:itemname_gunpartsexpensive) x20

Output:
* AK67 x20
